messages:
Rowan (People Ops): Heads-up: we've updated the 'Onboarding & Handbook Acknowledgements' section to include a mandatory acknowledgement step for two policy areas: Data Handling and PTO profiling. Please review and have new hires complete acknowledgements within their first 7 days. Link: https://redwood.internal/handbook/onboarding-ack.

Leah (Talent): Nice. Does this change the offer pack we send?

Rowan (People Ops): Slight change: add a short note in offer emails saying "Onboarding requires completing two acknowledgements within 7 days of start; we will assign the tasks on day 1." Also recruiting should trigger the bulk-assignment flow for cohorts.

Omar (Engineering): For people in our team who start as contractors but later convert to FT, do we retro-assign if they convert within 30 days?

Rowan (People Ops): If conversion happens within 30 days, HR will run a backfill assignment and mark completion status as "converted-assigned". Managers will be notified.

Tessa (Legal): Audit note: we need a tamper-evident export of acknowledgements (user, acknowledgement id, timestamp, ip). People Ops, can you ensure exports include ip and user-agent?

Rowan (People Ops): Yes. The export schema now includes user, ack_id, completed_at, ip, ua, manager. We'll store quarterly exports in the compliance bucket.

HR Bot: automated: Acknowledgement tasks assigned: "Data Handling - Onboarding" and "PTO Profile Acknowledgement" to 52 new hires. Due: 1742714676 (7 days). Link: https://lms.redwood.internal/onboard-acks

Leah (Talent): Can managers approve exceptions for folks on administrative leave?

Rowan (People Ops): Managers must file an HR ticket for exceptions; approvals are recorded in the HR ticket metadata. We'll treat those as documented extensions for audits.

Omar (Engineering): Are there manager-level reports? I'd like a view that shows which new hires haven't clicked the acknowledgements yet so I can follow up in first-week 1:1s.

Rowan (People Ops): Created a read-only manager dashboard and a CSV export. Managers with edit rights can request manager CSVs for their teams. Link: https://dash.redwood.internal/onboard-acks (manager single-sign on).

Tessa (Legal): Also confirm retention period for these acknowledgement records?

Rowan (People Ops): Two years minimum, per legal. We'll retain in the compliance bucket and back up monthly.

Leah (Talent): Great. We'll update the offer template and send a note to hiring managers.

Rowan (People Ops): I'll send a short slack announcement to #all-hands after we finish the release notes. If anyone needs the export format or sample CSV, ping me.

HR Bot: reminder scheduled: auto-reminder #1 to assigned users in 48 hours.

Omar (Engineering): Thanks, this will help close gaps during ramp.

Rowan (People Ops): Thanks everyone. Closing thread.
